title: phegopteris pyrrhorhachis
intro: Phegopteris pyrrhorhachis, commonly known as the autumn fern, is a species of fern native to Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris pyrrhorhachis include treating fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, as well as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
